source: The current Dao-AILab repository even exposes a KV-cache-oriented ZXNAME0000XZ interface with optional block tables, illustrating that kernel execution and cache paging are composable concerns rather than mutually exclusive ideas.[8]
zh: 当前的 Dao-AILab 存储库甚至公开了一个面向 KV 缓存的 ZXNAME0000XZ 接口以及可选的块表，说明内核执行和缓存分页是可组合的问题，而不是相互排斥的想法。 [8]
